Daiichi Sankyo manufactures prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and vaccines. The company focuses heavily on oncology (cancer treatments like Enhertu and Datroway) and cardiovascular disease (such as edoxaban and prasugrel), alongside medicines for infectious, metabolic, and rare diseases. [](https://www.daiichisankyo.com/products/)

- **Oncology:** Cancer-fighting drugs including **Enhertu** (fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki), **Datroway** (datopotamab deruxtecan), **Vanflyta**, and **Turalio**.

- **Cardiovascular & Thrombosis:** Anticoagulants and antiplatelet therapies like **Edoxaban** and **Prasugrel**.

- **Other Medical Fields:** Treatments for iron deficiency (Injectafer), vaccines, and general healthcare or over-the-counter wellness items
